title: Edit Distance
summary: Minimum inserts, deletes and replaces to turn word1 into word2.
approach: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] if chars equal, else 1 + min(insert dp[i][j-1], delete dp[i-1][j], replace dp[i-1][j-1]).
body: iOS link: fuzzy search and typo-tolerant matching in a local search feature.
